name: 曾恕銘
objective: 課程主要為介紹機器學習基本原理和應用，學習 DNN/CNN/LSTM/transformer 的神經網路架構和各種機器學習方法，以及資通訊技術應用實務
schedule:
1.	Introduction
2.	DNN with labs
case study: OFDMA/NOMA resource allocaion (無線多媒體通訊應用)
3.	Learning method with labs (AI 玩遊戲)
4.	CNN and object detection (Computer Vision 電腦視覺)
5.	RNN LSTM with lab
6.	Analogizers: K-means, kNN, SVM
7.	transformer (GAI/LLM)
case study: scene boundary detection (電腦視覺應用)
8.	(optional) Naïve Bayes classifier (AI 判斷貸款會違約嗎)
9.	(optional) Symbolists: Decision Tree (AI 判斷貸款會違約嗎)
10.	Autodecoder (AI 影像去雜訊/著色)  with labs
11. Deep Reinforcement Learning (AlphaGo 下圍棋勝世界冠軍，OpenAI Five 玩 Dota 2 勝世界冠軍)
case study STAR - RIS DRL (無線多媒體通訊，行動邊緣運算應用)(optional)
case study GNN DRL (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
case study UAV DRL (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
case study UAV DRL practical video transmission PSNR decoder (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
